description: Share one existing expense report after confirmation. Default to reviewer: they can open and edit that report's Google Sheet, inspect receipts, comment, approve, or request changes, but cannot act for the owner or use accounting integrations. Use accountant only when the user explicitly asks for ongoing accounting access; it creates the established accountant relationship and broader report-management workflow.

recipientRole.description: Use reviewer for report-only approval. Use accountant only for explicit ongoing accountant access.

name: share_report
